title: Remal the Black
summary: Protect Keelee through a personal paladin trial, then pursue Remal to the orc camp.
overview: Protect Keelee through a personal paladin trial, then pursue Remal to the orc camp.

sections.title: Encounter guide
bullets: An eligible paladin hails Keelee to start. During the initial ritual, other nearby characters are banished away; the initiator must handle the waves.
Four waves of four orcs arrive at two-minute intervals. All orcs must be dead when the final wave timer is checked or the event fails.
On success, Keelee and Remal move to another orc camp and Remal becomes attackable. Follow Keelee’s shout to the new location.
Defeat Remal within the final one-hour window, then the initiating paladin must hail Keelee for credit.

notes: Reviewed against quest source only; encounter behavior, database tuning and availability have not been verified in a live zone. Tactical advice is inferred from the scripted mechanics.
